name: Google Antigravity 2.0
description: Standalone desktop application for orchestrating multiple AI agents in parallel with scheduled background tasks, subagent workflows, and native integrations with AI Studio, Firebase, and Android. Breaks the 'prompt, wait, respond' pattern by letting agents run in the background on cron-like schedules. Includes CLI tool for running coding agents directly from terminal.

name: TestSprite 3.0
description: Autonomous end-to-end testing agent that uses parallel AI agents to explore apps, generate comprehensive test suites for frontend and backend, and auto-heal tests. Features include a parallel exploration fleet (dozens of agents mapping apps before tests are written), complex integration testing with dynamic variables, Data Flow debugging, and CLI integration for Claude Code/Codex users. Ranked #1 Product of the Day.

name: OpenHuman
description: Open-source AI harness that is local-first, privacy-first, with persistent memory across sessions using a Memory Tree with canonicalization, temporal metadata, and source authority scoring. Integrates with 118+ tools including Gmail, Slack, Telegram, Notion, and GitHub. Features tool calling with chaining, a code sandbox, and achieved 8000+ GitHub stars in first 7 days. Ranked #1 Product of the Week.

name: buildpipe
description: Local-first pipeline automation app for developers that chains shell commands, AI calls, HTTP requests, and file operations into reusable pipelines. Trigger pipelines on schedule, file change, or webhook. Features AI Build to describe pipelines in plain English, 48 templates, encrypted API keys stored locally, and no telemetry or accounts required.

name: Command A
description: Cohere's open enterprise workhorse model for development tasks, positioned as an open-source AI coding assistant.

name: Memdex
description: Tool that turns every AI conversation into reusable local memory, addressing the session persistence problem for AI coding workflows.

name: Vibedock
description: Mac menu bar utility for toggling Claude Code MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, providing quick access to Claude Code's extensibility system for developers.
